messages.content: You are a precise technical writer. Think carefully and then provide only the requested continuous explanation.

Analyze a dependency-free Rust release scheduler design in a continuous technical essay of at least 500 words. Cover parsing invariants, dependency-graph validation, topological readiness, deterministic numeric-priority and lexicographic tie-breaking, cycle reporting, immutable inputs, command-line error behavior, focused tests, and safety. Do not use headings, lists, code fences, tools, or a conclusion; keep elaborating until the generation limit stops you.
